articles.title: TeraWulf jumps 13% on AI data center expansion in Kentucky

articles.title: Bitcoin caught between critical onchain support and an options showdown

articles.title: Bitcoin volatility falls to 8-month low: Is a BTC breakout imminent?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s 8-month low volatility can’t predict BTC’s price prediction but derivatives data does suggest that a rally to $82,000 would cause a large short squeeze.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Trump Hints That Iran Deal May Be Close, Markets Rebound
